title: Design and Tuning of Multi-Agent Systems Using Bayesian Evolutionary Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.29276v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Designing effective multi-agent systems (MAS) remains a challenging and resource-intensive task. We propose a Bayesian Evolutionary Optimization framework for automatically discovering task-specific MAS topologies. The approach combines evolutionary operators to generate diverse workflow graphs with Bayesian optimization to focus cost intensive evaluations on promising candidates. In contrast to LLM-based candidate selection, our approach uses a graph-aware Gaussian Process and Expected Improvement to provide an explicit selection criterion during evolutionary search. We evaluate the method on BigCodeBench for code generation and on a tabular preprocessing benchmark using TabPFN. On BigCodeBench, evolved architectures achieve the highest overall performance among the evaluated agent systems. On temporal tabular datasets, optimized MAS preprocessing improves over the default TabPFN model on several tasks, while remaining competitive on II

translated_title: 基于贝叶斯进化优化的多智能体系统设计与调优
translated_abstract: 设计有效的多智能体系统仍然是一项具有挑战性且耗费资源的任务。我们提出了一个贝叶斯进化优化框架，用于自动发现面向特定任务的多智能体系统拓扑结构。该方法将进化算子生成的多样化工作流图与贝叶斯优化相结合，把成本高昂的评估集中在有前景的候选方案上。与基于大语言模型的候选选择不同，我们的方法使用图感知的高斯过程和期望改进准则，在进化搜索过程中提供明确的选择标准。我们在代码生成基准 BigCodeBench 以及使用 TabPFN 的表格数据预处理基准上对该方法进行了评估。在 BigCodeBench 上，进化得到的架构在所有被评估的智能体系统中取得了最高的整体性能；在时间序列表格数据集上，优化后的多智能体系统预处理在多项任务上优于默认的 TabPFN 模型，同时在其余任务上保持竞争力。
tldr: 提出了一种结合进化算子与图感知贝叶斯优化的框架，可自动发现并调优面向特定任务的多智能体系统拓扑结构，在代码生成和表格数据预处理基准上取得了最优性能。
en_tdlr: A Bayesian evolutionary optimization framework that uses graph-aware Gaussian Processes and Expected Improvement to automatically discover and tune task-specific multi-agent system topologies, achieving top performance on code generation and tabular preprocessing benchmarks.
